changelog.migration_note: Clients may regenerate OpenAPI and optionally adopt the perimenopause analyzer endpoint.
changelog.summary: Additive perimenopause STRAW+10 analyzer contracts and evaluation endpoint (Harlow et al. 2012). Stages bleeding-pattern variability and amenorrhea windows to -3b through +2; flags hormonal contraception, pregnancy, postpartum, lactation as suppressors and post-hysterectomy as inapplicable per STRAW+10 applicability limits.

changelog.migration_note: Clients may regenerate OpenAPI and optionally adopt the PCOS analyzer endpoint.
changelog.summary: Additive PCOS feature-pattern analyzer contracts and evaluation endpoint, aligned to the 2023 International Evidence-based Guideline (Teede et al.). Self-report features map to Rotterdam ovulatory-dysfunction and clinical-hyperandrogenism criteria; polycystic ovary morphology and biochemical androgens remain clinician-owned and out of scope for this analyzer.

changelog.migration_note: Clients may regenerate OpenAPI and optionally adopt the PMDD analyzer endpoint.
changelog.summary: Additive PMDD analyzer contracts and backend evaluation endpoint; calculation ownership clarified as hybrid.

changelog.migration_note: No migration required; first supported contract version.
changelog.summary: Initial Period v1 backend contract skeleton: domain models, Atlas trackers, settings, calendar feed, privacy manifest, local bundle validation, and contract snapshots.

compatibility_policy: Additive changes may extend schemas, endpoints, examples, or enum-adjacent metadata without removing fields. Breaking changes remove or rename fields, change value semantics, or make previously valid payloads invalid. Flutter should accept additive versions with regeneration/tests and require an explicit migration for breaking versions.
